direction: Calm, precise, a peer rather than a pitch. The product's whole claim is honesty, so anything that sounds like a hard sell works against the film. Downward inflection at sentence ends; no upward commercial lilt. Mid-to-low register, narration — never trailer, never energetic. One stressed word per line, no more; the `emphasis` field says which.

lines.text: Most resumes never reach a human. Software reads them first, and it's looking for exact words.
Carriv takes the resume you already have and rewrites it for the one job you're applying to.
Paste the posting, pick a profile, generate. One credit covers the resume, the letter, and the score.
What comes out is a single column. No tables, no graphics, no sidebars — typeset like LAY-tek, and parsed cleanly by the systems large companies run. Always one page.
Then a real score. Every keyword the posting wants, matched against yours — and for each gap, a rewrite that stays true to your experience.
Every edit is listed for you to read. Nothing is ever added that isn't already yours.
Then track every application — draft, applied, interview, offer — with your own notes beside each one.
And with the Chrome extension, tailor straight from the job page itself.
Three applications free, no card required. Carriv — a resume built for the job.
